newsitem.title: USA: Response Oncology says CFO Johnson leaves.
newsitem.headline: Response Oncology says CFO Johnson leaves.

text.p: Response Oncology Inc said on Thursday said Chief Financial Officer Daryl Johnson left the company to pursue other interests and Debbie Elliot, chief accounting officer, would assume his duties.
Elliot had been named executive vice president, finance and would perform the duties of CFO, the company said in a statement.
Response also said Larry Kugelman, chief executive officer and director of Coventry Corp, had been appointed a company director. Coventry was a managed health care organization.
